dictionary_induced_geometry.conclusion: Frozen hard-sparse maps introduce substantial chord roughness in these saved first-block residual states; raw model states also have nonzero curvature.
dictionary_induced_geometry.ratio_definition: Ratio of source-averaged actual decoded chord RMS to source-averaged raw chord RMS, pooling the balanced frozen paths; not mean pathwise curvature ratio.

audit.independent_replay: Canonical frozen encoder+dense decoder on first path/source, all36 arms, bothprecisions; exact canonical repeats

tests.provenance: Completed preflight tests/plants; first ineffective mutant preserved in verification_failure.json and failed_plants_v1.py.

qualifications: All 24 sparse arm means exceed raw-state chord means, but individual sources and paths need not do so.
Isolated dictionary chords use off-manifold activation interpolation; actual-path chords use saved native responses at the actual input midpoint.
Identity and fixed first-k PC projection have isolated chord RMS at roundoff; adaptive signed PCA TopK is nonlinear, not fixed rank-k projection.
Support switches coincide with resolved isolated curvature; unswitched learned maps can still include ReLU nonlinearity in principle.
FP64 only changes dictionary arithmetic over saved FP32 model states; it does not establish native-model FP64 accuracy.
These compressed representations have nonzero reconstruction error and altered secant response; results do not rank semantic quality.
Source n=16 synthetic backgrounds. One dictionary seed, k8/16, first-block residual coordinates, no inferential significance claim or general monosemanticity claim.
Nested uses the frozen simplified shared-code two-prefix recipe, not a full Matryoshka reproduction.

verification_failure_preserved.cause: Mutation changed decoder branch but encoder had already restricted coefficients to first-k PCs, so the planted behavior stayed linear and the known-answer test correctly still passed.
verification_failure_preserved.remedy: Replace method identity before both encoder and decoder branches so the mutant truly performs adaptive TopK.

dictionary_induced_geometry.next_decision: Close this saved-only comparison. Treat decoded sparse-path roughness as encoder-dependent and require raw-state, fixed-linear, support-turnover and precision controls in later interpretation; no new native/fitting/grid launch.

fixed_support_control.question: Locked k16 seed4951000; equal16-source means over the same768 paths, balanced axes/radii. Response is hidden-state perturbation response, not forecast accuracy.
fixed_support_control.conclusion: With the same weights and path-local central choices, freezing TopK membership removes the large excess chord roughness. Keeping versus freezing ReLU gives identical saved path metrics here, isolating TopK membership switching as the measured source of excess roughness in this fixed design.
fixed_support_control.fidelity_conclusion: Hidden-state perturbation-response reconstruction improves in every model/method mean. Mean state-reconstruction error worsens slightly in five of six comparisons and improves for TimesFM TopK. No better-encoder or forecast-accuracy claim.

audit.independent_replay: 18 arms,first registered path per16 sources,both precisions,exact reference repeats; all-path hard baseline agrees with parent

limitations: 16 synthetic sources, one seed,k16,locked first-block residuals; no broader claim.
Central support is chosen separately per path/token from actual input midpoint, not a deployable global mapping.
Isolated chord uses off-manifold activation interpolation; actual-path metrics use saved native outputs.
Response means hidden-state response, not native forecast response; native_calls=fit_calls=0.
Mean fidelity change is distinct from RMS change of reconstructed states, both preserved in compact_summary.json.
Native captures are FP32; dictionary main arithmetic FP64; FP32 replay samples one prescribed path/source.

parent_wording_correction.source: Parent dictionary_smoothness_distill.py qualification about unswitched learned maps
parent_wording_correction.correction: Parent support measured NONZERO active coordinates. Unchanged active support at the sampled chord points implies an affine map on those points. Observed active-support changes may combine TopK membership changes and ReLU zero crossings; the parent audit did not separate them. The fixed-index/live-ReLU and fixed-index/fixed-ReLU controls now separate these mechanisms.

fixed_support_control.next_decision: Branch closed. No broader grid, fitting, native capture or automatic expansion.
